text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, excuse me. I was just so happy to 
see you talking with so many different 
people, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
There are so many Umamusume here, after 
all. ...It's actually harder to be alone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, get to know everyone... and forge 
many wonderful bonds.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. I want to remain a part of 
your circle, Trainer. Please feel free to 
reach out anytime.
